character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the brutalist dawn world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in monolithic housing block, stepped concrete plaza, skybridge between towers; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with concrete grey, overcast white, dawn peach, moss green; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by symmetrical wide shot of a concrete monolith, slow tilt up a sheer wall, tracking along repeating balconies; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
